MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 11

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 7
   C. 17
   D. 23

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 90

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 11

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 1
   C. 20
   D. 9

8. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 170
   C. 13
   D. 169

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

11. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

12. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.025

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

14. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/2

16. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
